notes.note: Third choice of the allocation in the next free address dialog, beside "From the lowest address" and "From the highest address": the operator types the address to claim.
Heading of the address dialog when it claims a chosen address; {cidr} is the network.
Button of the address dialog that checks a chosen address with the server before the plan is shown.
Error under the address field when the typed address is not inside the network; {ip} is the text typed, {cidr} the network.
Hint under the address map for a person who may claim addresses in the network.

segment.source: Hover or focus a cell for its address; Enter opens it, or claims it when it is free.
segment.target: Hovra över eller fokusera en ruta för att se adressen; Enter öppnar den, eller tar den om den är ledig.
